title: Bodycam Shows Atlanta Officers Rescue Dog Tethered Next to Raging Fire
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
Atlanta, Georgia — Bodycam video shows the moment Atlanta police officers rescued a dog that was tethered just feet from a raging fire. While working at the scene of a vehicle fire in northwest Atlanta, Zone 1 units were made aware of a dog tethered to a tree near the vehicle, which was fully engulfed. The officers quickly leapt into action, placing themselves in harm’s way to free the dog. After finally getting him free, the dog was removed from danger and given the love he deserves.
